highlights: The AI agent ecosystem is rapidly maturing with breakthroughs in self-learning capabilities and persistent mistake correction, enabling more reliable and autonomous AI systems.
Major players are driving down API costs for advanced models and introducing powerful optimization techniques, making frontier AI more accessible and efficient for broad development and deployment.

Strategic enterprise partnerships and widespread adoption of AI solutions, alongside innovative open-source model releases, are accelerating real-world AI integration across diverse industries and specialized applications.

agents.title: Phronix: Capability-Centric Learning Paradigm for Agents
agents.summary: Phronix enables AI agents to autonomously acquire, validate, and refine reusable capabilities from their executions, drastically improving reliability and reducing token costs for recurring tasks.

agents.title: Self-Directed Repair: Agents Learn from Mistakes Persistently
agents.summary: This mechanism allows agents to distill lessons from failures into lightweight adapters, preventing repeated mistakes and improving overall success rates and knowledge transfer across new tasks.

agents.title: RSI-Opt: Self-Improving Optimizer Agents For Model Training
agents.summary: RSI-Opt introduces meta-agents that recursively self-improve model training processes by evolving prompts, playbooks, and code, leading to substantial gains in optimization efficiency and transferability for scientific machine learning.

models.title: OpenAI Launches GPT-6.1 Terra, Halving API Price for Agent Work
models.summary: OpenAI released GPT-6.1 Terra, a fast computer-use and vision model, significantly reducing API prices to make advanced agentic AI more cost-effective and accessible for developers.

models.title: Google Introduces Gemini 4 Argon, a New Frontier Model
models.summary: Google has made its latest frontier model, Gemini 4 Argon, available to developers, enterprises, and scientists, empowering them to tackle complex problems with advanced AI capabilities.

models.title: Hugging Face Releases Carbon-X: First Open DNA Language Model
models.summary: Hugging Face launched Carbon-X, a 14B open-source DNA language model that uniquely bridges DNA and natural language, enabling new chat-based applications in bio-AI research.

tools.title: Anthropic Launches OSS Scanner, a Free AI Vulnerability Scanner
tools.summary: Anthropic released OSS Scanner, a free, opt-in tool powered by Claude Mythos, designed to identify vulnerabilities in critical open-source projects, enhancing AI safety and security.

tools.title: TokenGate: Faster Long-Context Prefill for LLMs
tools.summary: Stanford and UC Berkeley researchers introduced TokenGate, a learned token pruning module that speeds up long-context LLM prefill by up to 11.3x and reduces peak memory by up to 3.4x without accuracy loss, making long contexts more efficient.

tools.title: OpenAI Introduces Decisions API for Responsive Apps
tools.summary: OpenAI launched the Decisions API, offering developers a fast, focused, and low-cost solution for integrating decision-making capabilities into applications, enabling more responsive and efficient workflows.

companies.title: OpenAI Expands Partnership with Oracle for ChatGPT Integration
companies.summary: OpenAI and Oracle are deepening their collaboration to integrate enterprise applications and AI agents into ChatGPT, and to power new Oracle offerings, significantly broadening ChatGPT's business reach.

companies.title: Uber Rolls Out ChatGPT Work to All Employees
companies.summary: Uber is deploying ChatGPT Work to over 30,000 employees, empowering teams with AI for research, data analysis, presentations, and complex workflow automation, marking a significant enterprise-wide AI adoption.

companies.title: Google Beam Expands Globally with New Partners
companies.summary: Google Beam is expanding to five new countries and partnering with Industrious, growing its network and making Google's AI capabilities more accessible to a wider range of customers and regions.

learning.title: Google's New AI Quest: Mapping the Human Brain
learning.summary: Google's latest AI Quest lesson, 'Polar Peaks,' provides an accessible and engaging opportunity to learn AI literacy through the lens of neuroscience and brain mapping.

learning.title: Profiling TorchNeuron (Part 1): System-level profiling on AWS Trainium
learning.summary: This guide offers a deep dive into system-level profiling for TorchNeuron on AWS Trainium, providing valuable insights and techniques for optimizing model performance on specialized hardware.

learning.title: Practical Principles for LLM Agent Distillation
learning.summary: This research provides practical principles for deciding how and when to best integrate teacher-generated vs. student-generated data in LLM agent distillation, offering crucial guidance for training more effective agents.
